also: listen when I talk to you

terms.gloss: I’m talking to you; it’s you I mean
evidence: Plaut. Men. 378: heus mulier, tibi dīcō
Ter. Eun. 337: Heus heus, tibi dīcō.
terms.comment: Said to someone who does not answer or will not stop, usually after heus.

evidence: Plaut. Curc. 516d: Heus tū, tibi ego dīcō.
Ter. And. 762: Tibi ego dīcō, annōn?

phrases.latin: Heus mulier, tibi dīcō. — Quid est?
phrases.english: Hey, woman, I’m talking to you. — What is it?

phrases.latin: Heus tū, tibi dīcō, manē, redī.
phrases.english: Hey you, I’m talking to you: wait, come back.
Hey, I’m talking to you! Aren’t you listening?

sources: Lewis & Short: dico
